name: Sefer Mikhlol (Radak)
author: David Kimhi (Radak)
versionTitle: Hebrew Wikisource edition based on the Venice 1545 text
attribution: Hebrew Wikisource contributors; medieval work by David Kimhi (Radak), with editorial notes by Elijah Levita and later Wikisource editors as identified on the pages.
changes: Imported the source edition’s 35 existing Hebrew sections as Amudi sections. Navigation and display markup were removed; no translation was made. Wikisource notes that biblical citations, vocalization, punctuation, paragraphing, and headings were edited or normalized from the Venice 1545 text.
sourceQuality: transcribed edition with documented editorial normalization
reviewNote: The Wikisource edition describes its basis and editorial changes. Amudi has not independently collated the transcription against the 1545 edition or the 1862 pagination scan. No complete English translation with explicit redistribution terms was identified.
coverageNote: Imported 35 sections listed by the Hebrew Wikisource contents template: prefaces, verb grammar, noun grammar, and word grammar. The source says the transcription is complete. Amudi has not collated it against the 1545 edition. No compatible full English translation was located.
